postThreshold.note: Only candidates that cleared the threshold get these.

rules.label: 4 minus the number of characters who follow it (never below 0), which helps small religions

character.randomization: Each candidate's total is multiplied by a random number from 5 to 14. The highest result wins.

roleScoring.note: Role points add to city points, family or not.

rules.label: Governor of a city with this religion (not the holy city)
Agent in a city with this religion (not the holy city)

threshold.description: The game rolls a threshold from 1 to 3. A religion is a candidate only if its city points plus role points are more than the threshold. The candidate with the highest final score wins.

whoRolls: Your own leader never converts on their own.
Anyone who already has a religion is skipped.
Religion heads, characters with the No Religion trait, and anyone under 10 cannot convert.
A non-leader with a locked-religion trait can only convert to that religion.
Each turn, each eligible character has a 10% chance to try.
An adult who passes the 10% roll goes ahead. A child under 18 goes ahead with a chance of 1 in (19 − age): 1 in 9 at age 10, 1 in 2 at 17.
